newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London static, HSBC up.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London static, HSBC up.

text.p: Hong Kong shares traded in London showed few signs of life on Thursday ahead of the long Easter weekend, with a rise in HSBC Holdings the only significant feature, dealers said.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index was 43.24 points firmer at 12,577.56 by 1456 GMT. Dealers said the bulk of this rise was accounted for by HSBC, which was around HK$1.5 up from its Hong Kong close.
Dealers said a few property shares were looking slightly better bid after a drubbing in Hong Kong.
"All we've really seen is book-closing ahead of the long weekend. People are taking an early bath," one dealer said.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng ended 242.07 points lower at 12,534.32.
